newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh to import 750,000 tonnes of diesel.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh to import 750,000 tonnes of diesel.

text.p: Bangladesh will import 750,000 tonnes of diesel to meet additional demands of fuel during the coming crop season beginning in November, The Daily Star newspaper said on Monday.
The newpaper quoted government sources as saying that 945,000 tonnes of diesel would be made available during the dry season from November to May when high yielding paddy is farmed.
Of that quantity, the local Eastern Refinery Ltd would supply 212,000 tonnes and the rest would be met by imports, the newspaper said.
The newspaper said that a government meeting on Sunday made plans to keep a ready stock of 70,000 tonnes of diesel to meet any emergency shortfall.
The government of Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina, which took over following general election in June, has pledged smooth supply of agriculture inputs to farmers.
